title: Hollow Stepper
description: A metallic, hollow FM sine bass that growls in the low register with garage swing. Its stepped FM index climbs through clashing harmonic ratios while a per-note pitch-envelope click snaps each hit, and a slow ladder-filter sweep opens the timbre across a 32-cycle morph before resetting.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine")
    .swingBy(1/3, 4)
    .fm("<4 7 11 5 9 14 6 8>/2")
    .fmh("<1 1.5 0.5 2 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<12 18 9 24>/4").pattack(0.004).pdecay(0.06)
    .lpf(sine.slow(29).range(220, 1900))
    .resonance(saw.slow(13).range(7, 16))
    .ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 5 3 6>/8").lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.08)
    .shape(0.34)
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .gain(0.9)
    .room(saw.slow(23).range(0.08, 0.3))
)
